results.text_preview: Three communal heating repairs raised between January 2024 and January 2025 were standard repairs and were attended within 1 day.
The landlord did not attend the emergency repair raised on 22 January 2024 within the timescales for an emergency repair.
The Ombudsman found maladministration in the landlord’s response to reports of repairs to the kitchen and sub flooring, and issues with damp and mould.
The landlord did not escalate the resident’s concerns about her floor after she reported them on 22 January 2025.
